## Some aspects about myself:

- *Position:* Associate Professor @ Dept. of Human Sciences, UniVR
- *Academic Sector:* PSIC-01/B – Neuropsychology and Cognitive Neuroscience
- *Research Interests:*
  - Body, action, space, and time representations and their influence on cognition.
  - The influence of social disconnection on cognition.
  - Metascience and methodology.

## Why Use R as a PhD Student?

- Free & Open-Source: No licensing costs, accessible to everyone.
- Powerful for Data Analysis: Handles statistics, machine learning, and big data.
- Reproducibility & Transparency: Ensures reproducible research with scripts and markdown.
- Extensive Community & Support: Large user base, numerous online resources, and active forums.
- Integration with Other Tools: Works with Python, SQL, and more.
- Visualization & Reporting: Creates high-quality plots (ggplot2) and dynamic reports (R Markdown).
- Customizability: Adaptable with thousands of packages for diverse research fields.
- Automation: Streamlines repetitive tasks and data processing.
- Strong Academic Adoption: Widely used in scientific research and publishing.
- Version Control & Collaboration: Works well with GitHub for team projects.
